en.name: Salamangreat Shrine
en.effect:
(This card is always treated as "Salamangreat Sanctuary".)
"Salamangreat" monsters you control are unaffected by your opponent's activated FIRE monsters' effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Salamangreat Shrine" once per turn. If you Link Summon a "Salamangreat" Link Monster, you can use 1 "Salamangreat" Link Monster you control with its same name as the entire material. During your Main Phase: You can shuffle any number of "Salamangreat" cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw the same number of cards.

zh-CN.name: 转生炎兽之神域
zh-CN.effect: 此卡名在规则上视为“转生炎兽之圣域”。此卡名的①③效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：自己要连接召唤“转生炎兽”连接怪兽的情况下，可仅以自己场上的1只同名“转生炎兽”连接怪兽作为素材来连接召唤。②：自己场上的“转生炎兽”怪兽不受对手的炎属性怪兽发动的效果影响。③：在自己的主要阶段可以发动。将手牌任意数量的“转生炎兽”卡放回牌组。然后，自己依放回的数量抽牌。
